scope: Published Action input_schema full recursive validation before claim reservation, with nonretrievable external schema registry and sanitized errors; same actual EIOS grants/Governor still required. Does not replace SQL business guards or implement human approval authority.
command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && PYTHONPATH=packages/eios-core/src:tests uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/test_published_action_input.py tests/test_action_definitions.py tests/test_role_mapping.py tests/test_consumer_resolution_pg.py tests/test_agent_governed_write.py --tb=short --junitxml=.ci-results/nx012-published-input-main.xml
discovery: An isolated Consumer-profile candidate demonstrated that upstream primitive Action parameters/required keys did not enforce a nested input_schema enum. This main regression directly tests legitimate published contracts and real restricted PG; invalid nested enum/type/missing/unknown fields produce zero claims or business writes; valid creation replays one persisted object/claim; external ref triggers no network request.
